personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean with Dubai-inspired Luxe Accents
personality_one_liner: A high-performance luxury real estate CRM combining Apple-grade iOS minimalism with elite Dubai-inspired gold and pearl accents.

spacing.rule: Generous touch spacing, clean padding, sticky lower-third primary actions with safe-area bottom clearance.

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky headers and bottom tab bars
Apply translucent glass overlays on luxury property hero cards
dont's: Do not apply blur to form inputs or dense tabular data
Do not use low-contrast text on glass surfaces

screens.name: Command Center & Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of today's key real estate metrics, lead pipeline funnel, active tasks, and quick role switcher between Agent and Admin.

states.loading: Centered minimalist gold spinner with branded typography
states.empty: Illustration + 'No recent command center activities' + Refresh action

screens.layout: Vertical scroll with safe area top, role switcher header, KPI metric cards, pipeline stage summary with vertical collapsible previews, quick action toolbar, and bottom tab bar.

screens.name: Lead Management Pipeline
screens.purpose: Full lead CRM pipeline from New -> Contacted -> Site Visit -> Negotiation -> Closed Won/Lost with auto-assignment and stage checklists.

states.empty: Illustration + 'No leads found in this stage' + 'Add Lead' CTA
states.error: Failed to sync pipeline data + Retry CTA

screens.layout: Segmented stage selector at top, vertical collapsible stage cards with deal values, client badges, quick action row (Call, WhatsApp, Edit, Delete), and sticky Add Lead floating button.

screens.name: Property Listings Catalog
screens.purpose: Full property CRUD with pricing, location, amenities, owner contact, status, and smart lead matching.

states.empty: Illustration + 'No properties listed' + 'Add Property' primary CTA

screens.layout: Search bar with filter chips (Off-Plan, Ready, Villa, Penthouse), 2-column image cards with price tags, status badges, and lead match indicator.

screens.name: Omnichannel Demo Inbox
screens.purpose: Simulated WhatsApp, Facebook, and Instagram lead messages with one-tap convert to lead workflow.

states.empty: No unread messages + 'All caught up' state

screens.layout: Inbox channel tabs (WhatsApp, FB, IG), message threads with preview snippets, unread badges, and prominent 'Convert to Lead' action button.

screens.name: Tasks, Reminders & Tools
screens.purpose: Task management with priorities, due dates, overdue highlighting, admin assignment, commission calculator, cap rate tool, and CSV export.
screens.layout: Segmented tabs for Tasks, Commission Calculator, and Cap Rate Tool, task cards with priority flags, overdue highlights, and modal calculators.

screens.name: Team, Admin & Analytics
screens.purpose: Admin performance tracking, agent leaderboards, response tracking, and revenue reporting.
screens.layout: Role-gated admin view, agent performance cards with conversion rates and flags, revenue summary charts, and CSV export triggers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a polished React Native Expo app with local persistence, Agent/Admin role switcher, full lead CRM pipeline (New, Contacted, Site Visit, Negotiation, Closed Won/Lost), property CRUD with lead matching, call logging, task management with overdue highlights, revenue calculators (commission, cap rate, cash flow), omnichannel demo inbox (WhatsApp, FB, IG) with 1-tap convert to lead, global search and notification center, and CSV export capabilities. Use clean iOS-native styling with Dubai-inspired gold and pearl accents.
